none: PAS STAFFS-6D19D7: The altar cross strip with Biblical inscription
contea di ritrovamento: Staffordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
surge d[omi]ne [et] disepentur (for dissipentur) inimici tui et fugent (for fugiant) qui oderunt te a facie tua

A strip of gold from the arm of an alter cross, with an inscription on both faces. Animal head terminal at one end, other ends in a setting. The inscription reads: 'surge d[omi]ne [et] disepentur (for dissipentur) inimici tui et fugent (for fugiant) qui oderunt te a facie tua'. or translated as: 'rise up, o Lord, and may thy enemies be scattered and those who hate thee be driven from thy face'.…
